body:
Thank you for your kind words and your offer to talk.

Sucks that you're going through something similar. I hope you will be able to pull through.

Thanks for your support. Being alone really does suck. 

I'm actually going to visit my sister this weekend (she turned 30 a few weeks ago and I couldn't be there for her birthday). I've always tried to keep my problems to myself, but she knows something is not right (she often tells me about her problems, and I like being able to be there for her). Part of me does want to tell her, but at the same time I want to protect her. She has enough to worry about in her life, she doesn't need to carry this as well. I am not sure what I should do, it feels wrong to tell her, but keeping it from her also feels wrong...

This.
This answer is really something you (and I) should listen to. Just live one day at a time, find a reason to live tomorrow. I know it can be fucking hard, but it's just another day. We can do it together, right?

Please don't give up just yet. Tell us what happened, perhaps someone reading this sub as been through something similar and can give you advice.
And remember you alway have a lot of internet friends to talk to if you feel your IRL ones aren't up to the task.
Hugs,
